engine.name: meilisearch
engine.keyword_setup: Not BM25; the harness sets `searchableAttributes` to the text field, sets `stopWords` to the Lucene English list the BM25 engines analyze with, searches with `matchingStrategy` `frequency` so a long question drops its commonest words first, reads `_rankingScore` as the score, and leaves every other setting at its default
